title: The Last Sign, and Seven Words Back
label: ch:bn-last-sign-seven-words
canDo: I can read the colours, the mouth and two of the numerals off the page, write the long-i sign that completes the script this book teaches, and say why every one of these words reached my ear before it reached my eye.

payoff.summary: One read as a vowel opening a word with no consonant to carry it, which finally makes visible the claim the numbers chapter could only assert; then twenty-six pieces and nineteen words counted back, all of them heard before they were seen.
